title: Agent Update: issue 149
text:
Agent Updates provide tax agents and advisers with updates, reminders and links to information, services and support from HMRC.

 The next edition will be out in December 2026.

 This month’s highlights include:

 • tax

 • borders and trade

 • Making Tax Digital

 • HMRC agent services

 • agent engagement

 If you would like to know when all future editions of the Agent Update are published, sign up to receive email reminders .
